class.name: NNBTUntilFail
class.brief_description: Repeats its child node until the child returns [code]FAILURE[/code], then completes with [code]SUCCESS[/code].
class.description:
The until-fail node ticks its first enabled child node repeatedly. A [code]FAILURE[/code] child completes the node with [code]SUCCESS[/code]. A successful child does not complete this node; it repeats the child on the following tick and only a child [code]FAILURE[/code] completes it with [code]SUCCESS[/code]. A [code]RUNNING[/code] child keeps the node running and is ticked again on the next tick.
The child is never reset on success; the normal run lifecycle starts the child's next run on the next tick.
The until-fail node must have exactly one enabled behaviour-tree child. With no enabled child it completes with [code]FAILURE[/code].
